limits: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (free), served by NVIDIA through OpenRouter: 868,928 tokens in, 131,072 out (OpenRouter's endpoint list, 2026-11-20)
OpenRouter free models, per account: 20 requests a minute, and 50 a day until you have bought $10 of credits in all, 1,000 a day after; the day resets at 00:00 UTC
A run takes about 4 model requests (median of 12 measured runs; the most was 5)
Reads the one page you give it; with Firecrawl added, Firecrawl sees that URL, so use public pages only

NVIDIA's free endpoint keeps data: under NVIDIA's API trial terms it may log what it is sent and use it to improve its products, AI models included, and asks you not to send confidential or personal data. It is not on OpenRouter's zero-retention list, so OpenRouter's "ZDR only" setting turns it off
NVIDIA's API trial terms are for trial use, not production
